entities.summary: John Fitzgerald Kennedy Jr., also referred to as JFK Jr. or John-John, was an American businessman, attorney, magazine publisher, and journalist. He was the son of the 35th U.S. president John F. Kennedy, and First Lady Jacqueline Kennedy.
